propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800-line complexity limit and conflates file I/O, JSON encoding, state rotation, and policy logic, risking silent data loss during refactoring without byte-level oracles.
A new BindingRepository module must own file paths and original dictionaries, returning typed views while preserving load/save byte contracts and exception behavior unchanged.
Rotation-before-live ordering, retired-first moves, sorted/indented/newline serialization, and best-effort alert writes must be preserved exactly across the extraction.
Public BindingStore facade, constructor, loader, signatures, and shared inner-entry behavior remain compatible; tickets publication seals only five bridge-state files with no eager rewrites.

Fault-injection tests must verify each named failure mode (tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write) leaves exact surviving file/byte state and raises or swallows consistently with pre-extraction behavior.
